$comment: REQ-END-002/003. Endless expeditions: a run that continues into deeper, scaled routes until the Guild AI turns back, the party breaks, or the ten-minute cap ends it. Every value is a data-driven default PENDING APPROVAL (v1.0 §20 lists numerical balance curves among the design owner's decisions). Monster stats scale per depth; item level never does (v1.0 §12). Rewards scale with routes cleared and with the objective's emphasis.

objectives.name: Maximum loot
objectives.description: Go deep for the haul. Resources matter less than what drops.

objectives.name: Survival
objectives.description: Stay alive as long as possible. The Guild AI turns back earlier and nobody is spent for a number.

objectives.name: Boss hunting
objectives.description: Every depth ends on the region's warden. Pays in essence.

objectives.name: Resource gathering
objectives.description: Bring back provisions and materials. Loot is incidental.

objectives.name: Exploration
objectives.description: Map what lies deeper. Occasionally turns up an Insight Crystal.

objectives.name: Record attempt
objectives.description: Depth is the point. Rewards are halved; the record is not.
